T: Revenge is a dish best served cold. Sushi too.
D: A former assassin wakes from a coma and goes after the people who tried to kill her.
P: Serve the sushi when the Bride walks into Hattori Hanzo's sushi bar.
S: the Okinawa sushi bar with a legendary swordsmith behind it
Sushi rice seasoned with vinegar, sugar and salt, shaped into nigiri with sliced salmon and tuna, a dab of wasabi, served on a board with pickled ginger.
the Tokyo restaurant before the fight
Pork, cabbage, garlic, ginger and spring onion folded into wrappers, fried until the bottoms brown, steamed under a lid, with a soy and black vinegar dip.
Corn cobs grilled until charred, brushed with miso butter, sprinkled with shichimi and spring onion.
M: Chicken thigh skewers and chicken and spring onion skewers grilled over high heat, brushed with a tare of soy, mirin, sake and sugar reduced. Rice.
Tonkotsu-style broth of pork bones simmered 8 hours, ramen noodles, chashu pork belly, soft egg and nori.
W: Matcha sifted and whisked into warm milk and cream, poured onto yolks beaten with sugar, cooked to 82C, strained, chilled overnight and churned.
K: Hanzo and the Bride share a drink
Junmai sake warmed to 45C in a flask, poured into small cups.

s.note: the Okinawa sushi bar with a legendary swordsmith behind it
s.how: Cook 300g sushi rice and season with rice vinegar, sugar and salt. Shape into small fingers. Top with slices of 150g salmon and 150g tuna and a dab of wasabi. Serve on a board with pickled ginger.
Grill 4 corn cobs until charred all over. Mix 50g soft butter with 1 tbsp white miso and brush over. Sprinkle with shichimi togarashi and sliced spring onion.

m.how: Simmer 80ml soy, 80ml mirin, 60ml sake and 2 tbsp sugar until syrupy for tare. Thread 1kg diced chicken thighs onto skewers, some with spring onion pieces. Grill over high heat, brushing with tare. Serve with 300g jasmine rice.

w.how: Whisk 2 tbsp matcha into 300ml warm milk and 300ml cream. Whisk 5 yolks with 120g sugar, pour over and cook to 82C. Strain, chill overnight and churn, or freeze and stir every 30 minutes.

d.note: Hanzo and the Bride share a drink
d.how: Pour 400ml junmai sake into a flask and warm it in a pot of hot water to about 45C. Pour into small cups and sip slowly. Never pour your own.
